meal.name: Garri and Soup
description: Prepared garri, also called eba, made by working commercially processed cassava granules into boiling water.
This record covers only the eba; the user chooses a separate soup. It is naturally vegetarian and vegan.
reasons: Boiling water hydrates the roasted cassava granules.
Firm turning makes a smooth swallow.
The selected soup remains a separate recipe choice.

ingredients.name: white garri, commercially fermented and roasted cassava only
ingredients.quantity: 350 g initially; use enough for a firm dough

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.quantity: 800 ml initially, plus a small hot reserve if needed

instructions: Measure the ready processed garri and water and set out a heatproof bowl and sturdy wooden spoon. This recipe starts with finished garri, not raw cassava.
Bring water to a rolling boil, allowing about 5 minutes. Pour 700 ml into the bowl, reserving the remaining hot water.

Sprinkle in garri gradually and turn firmly for about 3 minutes until smooth and stiff. Add more measured garri if too soft, or a little reserved boiling water if too hard; absorption varies by product.
Portion with the spoon, allowing about 2 minutes, and serve promptly with the user’s separately selected soup. Soup ingredients, instructions, time and dietary tags are excluded.
